d: At just three years old, Jyoti Bhatia’s life changed when polio took away her ability to stand and walk. What followed was a journey filled with challenges, loss and countless unanswered hopes. After losing her mother, she found support in her grandmother, who encouraged her to keep trying. With patience, discipline and an unbreakable desire to stand on her own feet, Jyoti slowly learned to walk again. She went on to complete her education, become a qualified teacher and achieve financial independence. Her story is about never giving up on life.
